flashcard_questions.q: The protagonist of A Christmas Carol, a wealthy miser who undergoes a moral transformation after being visited by three spirits.
Scrooge's underpaid clerk who represents the dignity and resilience of the Victorian working class.
A character who contrasts with another character, highlighting their differences and making each one's qualities more visible.

flashcard_questions.a: Bob Cratchit's youngest son, a disabled child whose potential death represents the human cost of social neglect.
A horn-shaped container overflowing with food and flowers, symbolising abundance and generosity.
